title: 第五章 我家的仓鼠成精了
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
“行动力？这游戏还有体力限制？”
沐游一愣，点开‘行动力’的词条。
【行动力：愚者在星灵界行走必须消耗的能量，你每次死亡和你遇到的每个分支选项，都会消耗一点行动力，行动力清空则无法行动。
当前行动力：0/5，每日零点自动恢复行动力至上限，也可用寿命恢复，每点寿命兑换一点行动力，是否兑换？】
“否否否！”
沐游急忙点否。
开玩笑，氪别的也就算了，氪命？
多走一步就要一年寿命，这谁氪的起！
不过，这个行动力，到底是怎么算的？
沐游疑惑看着文本中的那句说明：每次死亡和遇到的每个分支选项，都会消耗一点行动力。
他刚才实际总共死了两次，选项的话他也至少点了五六次，这加起来怎么也超过五点行动力了吧？
难道‘是否’之类的选项都不算数？
沐游一时想不明白，只好先放着。
看了眼时间，现在才下午六点，距离凌晨还早，今天肯定是玩不成了。
沐游退出游戏，走去将店外的卷帘门拉上。
随后迫不及待的取出了魔杖，准备先试一试刚刚学到的三个咒语。
第一个‘百发百中’需要远程武器，他店里肯定没有这种东西。
不过剩下两个咒语都可以当场试验。
沐游来到宠物展示区，将一只仓鼠笼子提了出来。
笼子里住着一只萌萌的小仓鼠，名叫‘十七’，是他两个月前刚购入的。

不过这货笨的一批，每天训练之下，这厮竟然至今还没有学会躺手和定点排便，让沐游颇为头疼。
所以，它荣幸的成为了沐游的第一个施咒对象！
可怜的小仓鼠，现在还不知道自己即将经历什么，仍然在笼子里四处拱着鼻子嗅来嗅去找吃的。
沐游将笼子提到大厅，摸到口袋中的魔杖。
不过想了想，他又去前台找出相机，在正对着笼子的方向架好了机位。
现在还不知道释放魔法时会出现什么动静，总之，先用相机拍摄一下试试。
架好机位，调试好角度，沐游取出了魔杖，呼了口气，将魔杖尖端对准仓鼠，轻声念出了动物对话的咒语。
“瓦拉……丢普……莫古……欧雷斯！”
这段音节之绕口，让沐游念了足足五秒才念完。
念完之后，一道隐约的光点从魔杖顶端浮现，迅速没入了仓鼠脑袋中。
笼中的仓鼠忽然顿住，仿佛被电击了一下一样，完全定格在了原地。
两三秒后，它才恢复了动作，扬起小脑袋望着沐游，小脸上忽然布满了一种拟人化的热切。
“想吃东西吗？”沐游手里捏着一袋坚果，尝试着问。
结果仓鼠竟然连连点头！
“嘶……”
沐游自己都感觉震惊，这效果也太明显了吧？就挥了下魔杖，居然就直接能听懂人话了！
“照我说的做，就给你东西吃。”
“吱吱！”
小仓鼠猛点头。
随后沐游开始给仓鼠下达各种常见命令。

其中大部分小仓鼠能直接听懂，听不懂的，沐游用手势给它示范过后，它也很快模有样的学了起来。
十分钟后。
“躺手……趴下……打个滚……做个俯卧撑……去滚轮上跑两圈……卖个萌……”
每当沐游下达一个命令，仓鼠就立即照做一下，随后急忙跑到笼边，睁着黑黝黝的小眼睛等待投食，不给吃的绝不做下一个。
甚至就连俯卧撑和翻跟斗这种，对仓鼠来说几乎不可能的动作，它也以不太标准的姿势勉强做了出来！
太神奇了有木有？
现在说这仓鼠‘成精’了，一点夸张成分都没有！
接着沐游又试验了一下陷阱咒。
他在储物间找了一块废弃的木板，放在空地上，对着木板施展了咒语。
魔杖挥动。
下一秒，木板直接变成了一快扁平的圆形陷阱，颜色几乎与周围地板融为一体，不仔细看的话，根本看不出来这里有东西。
陷阱做好，沐游将十七放出了笼子，随后命令它走过去。
小仓鼠听话的走到陷阱旁边，结果刚踩过陷阱的界限……
“啪！”
陷阱瞬间合拢，直接变成了一个球形的雕花笼子，将仓鼠牢牢地困在了其中。
小仓鼠吓了一跳，急忙用前爪拍打笼子，两只小眼睛求救似的看向沐游，嘴里吱吱叫个不停，眼泪就差在眼眶里打转了。
沐游赶紧过去救出了仓鼠。
结果这笼子的强度却比想象中大得多，他费了老大劲，才勉强扒开一条缝。
小仓鼠四腿乱蹬的从缝中钻出，趴在沐游手上，心有余悸，一脸幽怨看着他，那人性化的表情，将内心情绪展示的很明白：我这么相信你，你居然让我去踩陷阱？
随即还将两只前腿抱起，赌气似的扭过头，好像个受了气的小媳妇，沐游连喂了一小包坚果，并且承诺以后再也不坑它后，这才把它哄好。

至此，两个魔法试验完毕，效果都是出乎意料的惊人。
将仓鼠送回笼子，沐游走过去将相机取下，翻看了一下回放。
结果魔杖和魔法光影都被正常拍摄了下来。
“这么说，只有遗物是无法被普通人看见的？”沐游心想。
将后面录下的小仓鼠卖萌视频看完，他忽然意识到，这或许是一个机遇！
想了想，沐游将视频提取到电脑上，拆分开来，将那些神棍的画面统统删掉，只保留了小仓鼠在笼子里做出各种命令的画面。
接着，他又将之前录的这只仓鼠的视频，找了一些出来，剪了一些片段凑进去，最后做成了一段三十秒的视频。
视频的前半段，是未训练之前的仓鼠，各种笨拙，各种乱拉，对主人爱答不理。
而视频的后半段，则是它刚刚训宠完成后，那些检验成果的画面。
两边的对比，可以说是惨烈到了极点！
配上字幕，配上特效和音效，沐游取了个‘如何在十分钟内驯服一只仓鼠’的标题，随后将这视频发布在了他的B站账号上。
他在B站不是什么大UP主，但这么多年下来，粉丝也积累了2万多，再考虑到这个视频的质量，沐游估计这次的播放量应该不会太低。
content_en:
"Mobility? Is there any physical limit in this game?"
Mu You was stunned and clicked on the entry of 'mobility'.
[Mobility: The energy that the Fool must consume to walk in the star spirit world. Every time you die and every branch option you encounter, you will consume a little mobility. If the mobility is empty, you will be unable to act.
Current mobility: 0/5. Mobility is automatically restored to the upper limit at zero o'clock every day. You can also use lifespan to restore mobility. Each point of lifespan is exchanged for one point of mobility. Do you want to redeem it? 】
"No no no!"
Mu You hurriedly nodded.
Just kidding, forget about other things, but life?
One more step will cost you one year of life, who can afford that!
However, how is this mobility calculated?
Mu You looked at the explanation in the text with confusion: Every time you die and every branch option you encounter, a point of action will be consumed.
He actually died twice in total just now, and he clicked on the option at least five or six times. This adds up to more than five points of action, right?
Don’t options like ‘whether’ count?
Mu You couldn't figure it out for a moment, so he had to let it go.
I looked at the time and saw that it was only six o'clock in the afternoon, which was still early in the morning. I definitely wouldn't be able to play today.
Mu You quit the game and went to close the rolling shutter door outside the store.
Then he couldn't wait to take out his wand, ready to try the three spells he had just learned.
The first 'Always on target' requires a long-range weapon, which he definitely doesn't have in his store.
However, the remaining two spells can be tested on the spot.
Mu You came to the pet display area and lifted out a hamster cage.
There lived a cute little hamster named 'Seventeen', which he just bought two months ago.
However, this is a bunch of stupid people. After training every day, this guy has not learned to lie down on his hands and defecate at a fixed spot, which gives Mu You a headache.
Therefore, it has the honor to become Mu You's first curse target!
The poor little hamster still doesn't know what he is about to experience. He is still sniffing around in the cage looking for food.
Mu You lifted the cage into the hall and touched the wand in his pocket.
But after thinking about it, he went to the front desk to find the camera and set up the camera in the direction facing the cage.
We don’t know yet what kind of movement will occur when the magic is released. Anyway, let’s try to capture it with a camera first.
After setting up the camera and adjusting the angle, Mu You took out the wand, exhaled, pointed the tip of the wand at the hamster, and whispered the animal dialogue spell.
"Vara... Diop... Mogu... Ores!"
This syllable was so convoluted that it took Mu You a full five seconds to finish it.
After finishing reciting, a faint light point emerged from the top of the wand and quickly disappeared into the hamster's head.
The hamster in the cage suddenly paused, as if it had been shocked by an electric shock, completely frozen in place.
After two or three seconds, it resumed its movements, raised its little head and looked at Mu You, its little face suddenly filled with an anthropomorphic eagerness.
"Want to eat?" Mu You asked tentatively, holding a bag of nuts in his hand.
As a result, the hamster nodded repeatedly!
"Hiss..."
Mu You himself was shocked. Isn't the effect too obvious? I just waved my magic wand and I could actually understand what people were saying!
"Do as I say, and I'll give you something to eat."
"Squeak!"
The little hamster nodded sharply.
Muyou then began to give various common commands to the hamster.
The little hamster could understand most of them directly. For those that it couldn't understand, after Muyou demonstrated it with gestures, it quickly learned it in a decent manner.
Ten minutes later.
"Lie down on your hands...get down...roll around...do push-ups...go run around on the roller twice...act cute..."
Whenever Mu You gives an order, the hamster immediately obeys it and then hurries to the cage, waiting for food with its small dark eyes open. If it is not given food, it will not eat next.
Even push-ups and somersaults are almost impossible for hamsters.It managed to perform the impossible action in a less than standard posture!
It's amazing, isn't it?
Now to say that this hamster has become a sperm is not an exaggeration at all!
Then Mu You tried the trap spell again.
He found an abandoned wooden board in the storage room, placed it on the open space, and cast a spell on the board.
Wand waved.
In the next second, the wooden board turned into a flat circular trap. The color almost blended in with the surrounding floor. If you didn't look carefully, you wouldn't be able to tell that there was anything here.
After the trap was prepared, Mu You released Qi Qi from the cage and then ordered him to walk over.
The little hamster walked to the trap obediently, but just stepped on the boundary of the trap...
"Crack!"
The trap closed instantly and turned directly into a spherical carved cage, trapping the hamster firmly inside.
The little hamster was startled, and hurriedly slapped the cage with its front paws. It looked at Muyou with its two small eyes as if asking for help, and kept squeaking in its mouth, with tears almost rolling in its eyes.
Mu You hurried over and rescued the hamster.
It turned out that the strength of the cage was much stronger than expected. It took a lot of effort for him to just open a crack.
The little hamster scrambled out of the gap with its legs, and lay on Mu You's hand. It looked at him with lingering fear and resentment. The human expression showed its inner emotions very clearly: I trust you so much, and you actually let me step on the trap?
Then he picked up his two front legs and turned his head angrily, like an angry little daughter-in-law. Mu You even fed him a small bag of nuts and promised not to trick him again before he coaxed him back to health.
At this point, the two magic tests have been completed, and the results are unexpectedly amazing.
After returning the hamster to the cage, Mu You walked over, took off the camera, and looked at the playback.
As a result, the wand and magic light and shadow were captured normally.
"So, only relics cannot be seen by ordinary people?" Mu You thought.
After watching the video of the little hamster being cute, he suddenly realized that this might be an opportunity!
After thinking about it, Muyou extracted the video to the computer, split it up, and deleted all the scenes of the magic stick, leaving only the scene of the little hamster making various commands in the cage.
Then, he found some videos of the hamster that he had recorded before, cut some clips and put them in, and finally made a thirty-second video.
The first half of the video shows the untrained hamster, acting clumsily, jerking around, and being indifferent to its owner.
The second half of the video shows the test results just after the pet training was completed.
The comparison between the two sides can be said to be extremely tragic!
With subtitles, special effects and sound effects, Muyou titled it "How to tame a hamster in ten minutes" and then posted the video on his Bilibili account.
He is not a big UP player at Station B, but over the years, he has accumulated more than 20,000 fans. Considering the quality of this video, Muyou estimates that the number of views this time will not be too low.
